title: Capify
description: A minecraft mod that allows you to equip any Cape!
body:
# Capify

Create and use your own custom Minecraft capes completely client-side.

Capify allows you to upload a PNG image and wear it as a cape without requiring a Minecraft cape, a client subscription, or any server-side installation.

---

## Features
- Upload your own custom cape textures
- Simple and lightweight user interface
- Instant cape preview
- Client-side only
- Works in singleplayer and multiplayer
- No account modifications required
- No external cape services needed

Capify only changes how your character appears on your own client. Other players will not see your custom cape unless they are also using a compatible cape system.

---

## Why Capify?

Many cape systems require paid clients, subscriptions, or external services. Capify focuses on a simple idea:

**Your cape, your design, your choice.**
